title.en: DeskMate: A Tabletop Mobile Robot for XR Interaction
title.zh: DeskMate：用於 XR 互動的桌上型移動機器人

description.en: A tabletop mobile robot concept that integrates an existing XR controller, giving an otherwise idle controller an active physical role in XR experiences.
description.zh: 整合既有 XR 控制器的桌上型移動機器人，讓原本閒置的控制器能在 XR 體驗中扮演主動的實體角色。

description.en: Exploring how physical objects, movement, and tangible feedback can extend interaction in immersive environments.
description.zh: 探索實體物件、移動與具體回饋如何延伸沉浸式環境中的互動方式。

description.en: A collection of experiments connecting digital experiences with physical artifacts and responsive systems.
description.zh: 一系列結合數位體驗、實體物件與回應式系統的探索與實驗。
